description: Traffic Signals Tabular is a dataset listed in City of Toronto open data portal, an open data portal, published or maintained by City of Toronto. Please see "Traffic Signal Tabular Readme" for more info This dataset contains all the locations of the traffic signals in the City of Toronto with their operational characteristics, such as: type of system that controls the signals accessibility (Audible tone) countdown timer for pedestrians (y/n) rail/fire/transit/fire priority feature (y/n) date signal was activated (y/n). Coverage: Toronto. The portal files it under the publisher City of Toronto. Its tags are flashing beacons, intersections, pedestrian crossover, traffic signals. It offers 28 resource(s) in CSV, GEOJSON, GPKG, SHP, XLSX. The portal shows 2026-09-26 as the last update. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, parking and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-am-toronto-portal.
